title: Orientia tsutsugamushi real-time PCR
author: Judy A Northill
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rhfd33n
materials: The assay has been optimised and validated for the Rotor-Gene 6000 and Rotor-Gene Q thermocyclers. PCR *Florescence acquisition step

steps.title: Prepare PCR Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction mixture for the total volume of 20µL per reaction, including a 'dead volume' (typically 2 extra reactions) or as required for a robotic dispenser.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 15µL of 2X SensiFAST probe Lo-ROX mix (Bioline, BIO-84020) into each reaction well.

steps.title: Add Template DNA
steps.instruction: Add 5µL of template (extracted DNA, controls, or nuclease-free water for NTC) to each reaction well to reach a total volume of 20µL.

steps.title: Run Real-Time PCR
steps.instruction: Perform the assay using a Rotor-Gene 6000 or Rotor-Gene Q 5-plex with 100-place rotor discs.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the real-time fluorogenic PCR results based on the amplification curves.

substeps.instruction: Verify the presence of a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase).
Confirm fluorescence intensity is at a suitable level compared to the positive control.
Identify the threshold cycle (CT) value where the curve exceeds the predefined threshold in the log-linear phase.
Classify results as negative if the CT value is 40 cycles or if NTCs do not produce a curve.
